page_title: MON 1-3 STU | B. Monchengladbach v Stuttgart 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Felix Brych is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The attendance is 53756.
90+2' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Brych had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+1' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and Felix Brych immediately signals a free kick.
89' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
88' Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
87' Referee Felix Brych sees the trip by Anrie Chase (VfB Stuttgart) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. B. Monchengladbach get a free kick.
86' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) plays a lovely through ball to El Bilal Toure, but he can't beat Jonas Omlin and loses the ball.
84' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
83' Substitution. Jamie Leweling makes his way off the pitch and Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as his replacement.
81' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
79' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Jonas Omlin is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
78' Alexander Nubel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
77' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
76' Here is a change. Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Cvancara.
76' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Florian Neuhaus replaces Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
75' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Ermedin Demirovic is replaced by El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Fabian Rieder cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) receives a decent pass from Robin Hack and immediately goes for goal from mid-range. It's a fine strike but the ball goes just over the bar.
72' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is repeatedly being caught offside.
69' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
69' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' A great solo run by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Alexander Nubel.
67' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
65' Franck Honorat comes off the pitch to be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
65' A substitution has been made. Philipp Sander is replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
64' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
63' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Deniz Undav and he is replaced by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).
63' The substitution is prepared. Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Josha Vagnoman.

61' 1 - 3 Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Fabian Rieder. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:3.
61' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
61' What a great touch by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. Stuttgart win a corner.

57' 1 - 2 What a goal! Fabian Rieder plays it to Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Jonas Omlin into the roof of the net. 1:2.
56' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but it's cleared.
53' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.

50' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley directed low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
48' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Alexander Nubel scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.

46' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
46' Referee Felix Brych blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
41' One of the players from B. Monchengladbach times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
37' The referee is firm and issues Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) a deserved yellow card.
36' 8:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 5:3.

32' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Alexander Nubel, who pulls off a stunning save!
32' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

31' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.

30' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
29' Alassane Plea is being substituted because of an injury. Gerardo Seoane sends Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) on the pitch.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Kevin Stoger finds Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 1:1.

26' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Alexander Nubel, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
23' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jonas Omlin comes off the line to clear the ball away.
22' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Stuttgart was in an offside position.

21' 0 - 1 Jamie Leweling fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:1.
20' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
19' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends a long ball in, but Jonas Omlin comfortably gathers the ball.

17' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Felix Brych blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

16' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Jonas Omlin leaps like a salmon to deny him.
14' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
12' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Felix Brych who sees an offensive foul.
8' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
6' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

6' A sweet pass finds Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Alexander Nubel is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.
5' That's unlucky! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
4' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
4' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) makes a slide tackle, but referee Felix Brych blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick.

3' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
